name: Airwolf XL SchnerMod 0.4 nozzle
machine_end_gcode:
M104 S0 ; nozzle off
M140 S0 ; bed off
M107 ; fan off

G91 ; relative
G1 E-2 F1800 ; retract
G1 Z10 F3000 ; lift
G90 ; absolute

G1 X0 Y200 F6000 ; present the print
M84 ; motors off
machine_start_gcode:
; --- Airwolf XL SchnerMod ---
G90 ; absolute coordinates
M83 ; extruder relative mode

M140 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; start heating bed
M104 S150 ; warm but below the oozing point
M190 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; wait for bed

G28 ; home with a cool nozzle so the probe stays clean
M420 S1 ; restore saved mesh

; park at the front-left corner BEFORE the final heat-up, so whatever oozes
; while M109 waits lands off to the side instead of over the build area
G1 Z10 F3000
G1 X5 Y10 F6000
M104 S[first_layer_temperature]
M109 S[first_layer_temperature] ; wait for nozzle, parked

; double prime line - out and back - to purge the ooze and stabilise flow
G92 E0
G1 Z0.28 F600
G1 X10 Y20 F6000
G1 X10 Y180 E16 F1200 ; pass 1
G1 X10.6 Y180 F6000
G1 X10.6 Y20 E16 F1200 ; pass 2
G92 E0

; break the string away from the nozzle before starting the part
G1 E-0.8 F2100
G1 Z2 F3000
G1 X25 Y20 F6000
G92 E0
